question: For renewable plants commissioned from the start of 2026, what is the upper size limit for getting priority when system operators dispatch generation?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 12(5) says that for facilities commissioned from 1 January 2026, point (a) of paragraph 2 applies only to renewable facilities under 200 kW. Article 12(2)(a) sets the earlier 400 kW threshold, so the reference answer is fully supported.", "other_articles": [{"doc_id": "dir_2019_944_art31", "answers": "partially", "why": "Article 31(4) lets a Member State require priority dispatch for renewables and cogeneration but gives no size limit; it refers to Article 12 of Regulation 2019/943."}], "ambiguity": "minor", "ambiguity_reason": "The question could be read as asking whether Article 12(3) derogations or Article 12(4) cogeneration apply, but it clearly points to the renewable 200 kW limit.", "suggested_fix": ""}

verdict.gold_reason: Article 12(5) says that for facilities commissioned from 1 January 2026, point (a) of paragraph 2 applies only to renewable facilities under 200 kW. Article 12(2)(a) sets the earlier 400 kW threshold, so the reference answer is fully supported.

other_articles.why: Article 31(4) lets a Member State require priority dispatch for renewables and cogeneration but gives no size limit; it refers to Article 12 of Regulation 2019/943.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question could be read as asking whether Article 12(3) derogations or Article 12(4) cogeneration apply, but it clearly points to the renewable 200 kW limit.
